message.content: {"Unknown": ["The DMCA 1201 prohibition on distributing tools that break DRM forces users into using forbidden underground devices.", "I would eliminate DMCA anti-circumvention laws entirely and go further by making the sale or import of any product with DRM a crime.", "DRM is evil, and I refuse to accept or support any system that restricts sharing, which I view as a good thing.", "The current copyright system is hypocritical because it supports businesses that screw artists rather than the artists themselves."]}
